senses.gloss: €1P. (खटति) To desire; wish.
€10P. (खट्ट्यति) To cover, screen.
(त्) ind. The sound made in clearing the throat; खात्कृ to clear the throat (Mar. खाकरणें).

[खट्-अच्] 
__1 Phlegm. 
__2 A blind well. 
__3 A hatchet. 
__4 A plough. 
__5 Grass. 
__6 The closed fist. 
__7 A kind of blow or wound. 
-Comp. 
-कटाहकः a spitting-box. 
-खादकः 
__1 a jackal. 
__2 a crow. 
__3 an animal. 
__4 a glass-vessel. 
__5 an eater.

खाटः,
 
-टा, -टिका, -टी f. A bier, a bed-stead on which dead bodies are carried to the cemetery.

__1 A man whose business is to negotiate marriages; cf. घटक. 
__2 The half-closed hand. 
__3 The doubled fist of wrestlers or boxers.
A bed-stead, a seat; (Mount Abu Inscrip. No 1. 5. 4. Ep. Ind. Vol. III).

A particular position of the hand in shooting. 
-खः A man in the attitude of shooting.

The hand half-closed. 
-का 
__1 Chalk. 
__2 The external opening of the ear.

__1 A butcher. 
__2 A hunter, fowler. 
__3 The cream on buffalo-milk. 
-का 
__1 A small bed-stead, a cot. 
__2 A bier.

खट(ड)क्किका
A side-door, window.

खटिनी,
खटी Chalk.

a. Dwarfish. 
-नः A dwarf.

__1 A bed-stead. 
__2 A kind of grass.
-शी The civet-cat.
m., f. A bier.

[खट् वा° इन्] 
__1 A bier. 
__2 A scar. 
__3 Caprice, whim.
a. Dwarfish.

[खट्-क्वुन्; cf. [[Uṇ. 1. 150]]] 
__1 A bed-stead, couch, cot; सहखट्वासनं चैव सर्वं संग्रहणं स्मृतम् [[Ms. 8. 357.]] 
__2 A swing, hammock. 
__3 A kind of bandage. 
-Comp. 
-अङ्गः 
__1 a club or staff with a skull at the top considered as the weapon of Śiva and carried by ascetics and Yogins; [[Māl. 5. 4]], 23. 
__2 N. of Dilīpa; °धर, °भृत् an epithet of Śiva. 
-अङ्गिन् m. an epithet of Śiva; [[Bhāg. 4. 19. 20.]] 
-आप्लुतः, -आरूढ a. 
__1 lying on a bed. 
__2 low, vile. 
__3 abandoned, wicked. 
__4 silly, stupid. 
__5 erring, going wrong or astray; खट्वारूढो जाल्मः । नाति व्रतवान् [[Mbh.]] on [[P. II. 1. 26.]] खट्वारूढः प्रमादवान् [[Bk. 5. 10.]]
Den. P. To use as a couch; सोपधानां धियं धीरां स्थेयसीं खट्वयन्ति ये [[Śi. 2. 77.]]

खट्वाका,
खट्विका A small bed-stead.
